dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave curvature on the posterior edge extending from the dorsal insertion to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-degree incline relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex arc with a large radius of curvature fitting the frontal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a visible length approximately 0.25 times the height of the cranial region.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 160 degrees at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Artificial cyan and teal luminescent color mapping across the entire visible surface.
